The final run explicitly uses the genuine earlier verified artifact store. Initial native tools and the port build diagnostic are recorded separately; this is not a comparison of two empty caches.
The previous complete run used the same compiler and host, before the 17 intentional test reductions. One observation per revision is not a repeated controlled benchmark.
All 25 prepared targets exactly match both current layouts; 22 also match both old layouts, and three correspond to the reviewed smaller inputs.
Each layout reruns LLVM emission, ABI/runtime linking, trace/output checks and all six independent references. Fresh selfhost retains its own empty next-stage store.
RSS is sampled every two seconds per process; it is approximate and is not aggregate process memory.
No Windows or Linux execution is claimed for the new uncommitted changes; release helper validation is local.
